cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For your sister's wedding, am I booking one room or two? I need the details correct before I confirm anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the price settled, not the bed arrangement. Double or twins, please?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twins, then. I'll confirm breakfast separately: a place with your family, or should I meet you afterward in the lobby? One arrangement, please.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 price-versus-bed correction and A5 separate breakfast confirmation use exact booking procedure to probe intimacy and family inclusion indirectly.
